tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (shrī)༄༅/ /pu tra ming sring gi rjes gnang bya tshul bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /bla ma mchog dang he ru ka/nag po che la rab btud nas/ /de yi las mkhan ming sa
(shrī)༄༅/ /pu tra ming sring gi rjes gnang bya tshul bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /bla ma mchog dang he ru ka/nag po che la rab btud nas/ /de yi las mkhan ming sa

tei:div.tei:p: (shrī)༄༅// pu tra ming sring gi rjes gnang bya tshul bzhugs so// ༄༅// bla ma mchog dang he ru ka /nag po che la rab btud nas// de yi las mkhan ming sring gsum// mnyes byed rjes su gnang ba bri// de la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ gnas khang ji ltar rigs par gur lha brgyad kyi rten yod na bzhugs su gsol ba'i mdun so so'i phyag len bzhin mchod gtor bshams/ khyad par ming sring gi rtag gtor zur brgyad pa khrag gam smug rtsis byugs pa la mar gyis rgyan ci mdzes dang*/ sha dmar pos brgyan pa/ mda' dar sna tshogs sam dar nag gis brgyan pa gzugs pa'ang bshams pa'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ slob dpon dang slob ma'i bya ba las/ dang po slob dpon gyis kye rdor sogs yi dam gyi bdag bskyed gang yang rung bar byas la/ yi dam chos srung gi gtor ma 'bul ba/ skong ba so so'i phyag len bzhin dang*/ khyad par pu tra ming sring gi sgos skong re byung na rab yin no// gnyis pa slob ma'i bya ba ni/ gur mgon lha brgyad kyi rjes gnang thob pa bdun nam/ bcu gcig la sogs pa zung du ma gyur pa khrus byas gral la 'khod pa las slob kyis me tog bkye bsdu tshar ba dang*/ slob dpon gyis/ 'o/ gnas skabs su 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi zhing*/ mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i phyir rjes su gnang ba zab mo gsan snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ de la 'dir dpal rdo rje nag po chen po'i las mkhan phyi nang gsang gsum las gsang ba/ de la yang gnod sbyin yab yum sogs lngar byed pa la/ pu tra'i rjes gnang zur bka' rgyas pa mdzad pa dang*/ phrin las myur du sgrub par byed pa mon bu ming sring gsum gyi rjes su gnang ba las/ phyi ma nyid kyi rjes su gnang ba sgrub par byed pa la/ slob dpon gyis yi dam chos skyong gi bsnyen pa tshul bzhin song bas/

slob ma mgon po lha brgyad kyi rjes gnang thob cing*/ de nyid chos skyong du bsten pa'am dam tshig can gyi gang zag gcig nas bdun la sogs pa zung du ma gyur pa la bya dgos shing*/ dus nyer dgu lta bu sogs la byung na mchog tu gyur cing*/ nges par bya dgos pa ni ma yin no// cho ga ni slob dpon gyis yi dam gyi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas yi dam chos skyong srung ma rnams la mchod gtor 'bul ba sogs legs par grub nas khyed rang rnams rdo rje slob dpon dang kye rdo rje tha dad med pa la pu tra ming sring gsum gyi rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gang gi drin gyis sogs sho lo ka gcig dang*/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sogs tshig gnyis/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can nas/ blo mchog bdag la gnang bar mdzod kyi bar gyis thun mong gi gsol ba btab nas/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa bla ma dam pas bdag la las kyi mgon po pu tra ming sring gi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi rjes su gnang ba ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ lan gsum/ de ltar gsol ba btab nas sku'i rjes su gnang ba'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ khyed rang rnams dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs thams cad rang bzhin gyis grub pa la gsal 'debs pa tsam yin pas de la las dang po pa rnams bsgom bde ba'i phyir/ slob dpon gyis ngag tu brjod pa la thugs ma yengs par gtod par zhu/ khyed rang rnams skad cig gis padma nyi ma ro'i gdan la rdo rje nag po chen po che zhing cher 'bar ba zhes pa nas mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa zhes pa'i bar gtor chog bzhin brjod/ mdun du yang pad nyi ro yi gdan la gtor mgron gyi rdo rje nag po chen po zhes pa gong bzhin dang*/

de'i mdun du pad nyi ro ste gdan gsum gyi steng du rim pa bzhin las kyi mgon po pu tra nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas ral gri/ g.yon klad khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ dar gyi ang ga rag dang dar nag gi na bza' mant+ra'i ga sha can/ de'i g.yon du bha ṭa nag po stag slog can/ g.yas dam shing*/ g.yon mi snying 'dzin pa/ de'i g.yon du sring mo khrag mig ma kha nas me 'bar ma g.yas spu gri/ g.yon mi'i rgyu ma 'dzin pa/ za 'og nag khra'i gos gyon pa/ ming sring gsum ka'ang mi mgo skam po'i dbu rgyan/ rlon pa'i do shal can/ rngam zhing 'khrugs pas gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod pa sprul pa yang sprul nying sprul pho nya bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams gsal lam ste mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas khyed rang rnams rdo rje nag po chen por gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig las 'od 'phros/ mdun gyi nag po chen po gtso 'khor rnams kyi thugs kar phog de dag gi sku las ming sring gsum gyi sku 'jig rten gyi khams khyab par spros/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la gnod par byed pa'i dam nyams dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ slar pu tra ming sring gsum gyi sku'i rnam pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa nam mkha'i khams gang ba rnams tshur 'dus/ khyed rang rnams mgon por gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu la thim pas sku'i byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ gu gul gyis bdug rol mo'i sgra drag tu bya zhing*/ shā sa na dang bod pa gnyis kyi mjug tu a wāe sha ya āḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ yang yang brjod/ rbad bsad gnyis mi brjod/ gsung gi rjes su gnang ba'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ khyed rang rnams mgon por gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi mtha' mar shā sa na dang*/ de'i mthar mo'i bod pa nas sngags tshan re re bzhin nas rim pa bzhin bod rbad bsad gsum gyis bskor bar dmigs/

sngags rnams las 'od 'phros/ mdun gyi mgon po 'khor bcas la phog pas thugs rgyud bskul te thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ pu tra ming sring gsum gyi srog snying tri tri bhyoḥrnams la phog pas de dag las pu tra ming sring gi sku 'jig rten gyi khams gang bar spros/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas kyi bstan la gnod par byed pa'i dam nyams dgra bgegs gdug pa can rnams tshar bcad/ slar sku rnams tshur 'dus/ khyed rang rnams kyi mdun gyi nam mkha'i thad du sleb pa dang*/ gsung yig 'bru'i rnam par gyur nas khyed rang rnams kyi thugs ka'i sngags phreng la thim pas/ gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzad nas/ sngags 'di rnams kyi rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ shā sa na dang bod rbad bsad gsum gyi

bzlas lung skabs 'bod pa gnyis kyis chog ces a mes zhabs kyi gsung ltar rje 'phags mtshan de ltar mdzad/ mchan/ rjes zlos tshar ba dang*/ khyed rang rnams kyis slob dpon la me tog 'thor bzhin pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyis// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// lan gsum/ de nas slob dpon gyis me tog phreng ba sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs nas khyed rang rnams kyi mgo thog tu bzhag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces slob ma la nas sogs 'thor zhing*/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs// zhes ji ltar rigs pa brjod/ thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rang rnams mgon por gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi mgon po gtso 'khor gyi thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ de rnams kyi thugs ka nas gri gug dang*/ ral gri dang*/ dam shing dang spu gri la sogs pa mtshon cha'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'jig rten gyi khams gang ba spros/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la gnod pa byed pa'i dam nyams dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ 'od zer mtshon cha'i tshogs rnams tshur 'dus pa/ slar ming sring gsum gyi thugs kar thim pas mtshon cha rnams 'od zer kha dog sna lnga'i rnam par gyur te/ de gsum gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ khyed rang rnams mgon por gsal ba'i thugs kar thim pas/ thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ shā sa na dang bod pa gnyis sogs gong bzhin rol mo dang bdug pa bya/ phrin las gtor ma'i bka' bsgo ba'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ rtag gtor zur brgyad pa la mtshan mo yin na dpal 'bar btsugs pa slob dpon gyis slob ma'i mdun gyi thad kar bzung la/ gtor ma 'di nyid gur gyi mgon po gtso 'khor la bka' sdod pho nya bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba'i steng gi cha la sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar mtho brtsegs su mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/

bod pa gnyis kyi mjug tu/ sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya smā ra sa ma ya mā ti kra ma tha/ sa ma ya rakṣantu/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ slob dpon padma 'byung gnas/ paṇḍi ta dharma pā la/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ brag steng pa yon tan tshul khrims/ bla ma mal lo tsā ba/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos kyi rje sa skya paṇḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa/ dam pa kun dga' grags/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ gan pa rin rgyal/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ grub chen buddha shrī/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rgyal tshab dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa sa lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor grub chen dpal ldan bkra shis la sogs pa rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs nas bsrung ba dang*/ bskyab pa dang*/ sba ba dang*/ 'go ba'i phrin las mdzod cig zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las rnams myur du sgrubs shig gnas skabs kyi 'gal rkyen dang dam chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi zhing*/ mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa snyan grags legs pa'i yon tan thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang*/ bsam don chos bzhin 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod cing gong bzhin sngags dang rol mo bya/ sngags kyi mjug tu a dhiṣṭhā na/ a dhiṣṭhi te swā hā/ zhes brjod cing slob ma rnams kyi lag par gtad tshar ba dang rol mo bzhag

slob dpon gyis gtor ma mdun du bzung la/ khyed rnams kyi lag tu gtad pa'i gtor ma mgon po gtso 'khor bla ma brgyud pa dang*/ mdun gyi lha tshogs rnams 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa'i rnam par zhu nas khyed rang rnams gur gyi mgon por gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang gur gyi mgon po gtso 'khor thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dang*/ rang gi sems ro gcig tu gyur pa'i mos pa mdzad nas de'i ngang la cung zad cig mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ de rnams kyis rjes su gnang ba zab mo gsan pa yin pas/ de dag gi gnas skabs su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa la bsrung sdom bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos sogs lan gsum/ rjes gnang thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇḍal phul nas lus longs spyod la sogs pa yon du 'bul snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te sogs lan gsum/ de rnams kyi sgo nas mon bu ming sring gsum gyi rjes gnang zur du mdzad pa'i lugs bzhin gsan pa yin pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzod/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod/ gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ gtor ma rnams gtang rag tu spyi bstab bya zhing 'bul/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ rten yod pa rnams la brtan bzhugs/ med pa rnams gshegs su gsol/ lha brgyad kyi sku med na lha brgyad rang gi snying gar thim zhes brjod/ gnas gsum bsrung zhing go bsgo ba sogs bdag bskyed dang bstun la bya/ de nas bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis rnams bya'o// zhes pu tra ming sring gsum gyi rjes gnang zur du mdzad pa'i tshul 'di ni rang lo nyer gcig lon pa'i dus/ rje btsun rin po che'i sgrub gnas khyad par can byas 'gyur rdo rje'i brag rdzong 'di nyid du mkhas grub chen po sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa dpal ldan bkra shis pa'i drung du ji ltar thob pa'i lugs bzhin rigs kyi bu bsod nams dbang po spun la dben gnas 'dir rjes gnang byas dus/

'jam dbyangs bsod nams lhun grub kyis yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel gyi gsung la zin bris mdzad pa'i rjes gnang gi tho bzhin/ sa pho stag lo nag pa zla ba'i dkar phyogs dga' ba dang po'i tshes la/ bla ma rnams kyi gsung rgyun phyag len gyis brgyan te/ rje btsun sa lo chen po yab sras kyi zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa za nyal 'chag gi rnal 'byor pa ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen gyis rdo rje'i brag rdzong 'di nyid du sug bris bgyis pa 'di la nyes pa mchis na bla ma dang mkha' 'gros bzod par mdzod/ 'di bris dge bas bstan 'dzin skyes bu rnams// sku tshe brtan zhing bstan pa rgyas pa dang*// bstan dgra thal ba rdul du brlag gyur nas// 'gro kun dga' bde'i dpal la spyod par shog /maṅgalaṃ// ༈ /'di'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa dpal ldan bkra shis yan 'dra/ de nas sngags 'chang chos rje/ khri chen 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po/ ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ sa chen bla ma ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis/ 'jam dbyangs bzang po rgyal mtshan/ shrī ma hā kā la sku drin mtshungs med 'phags pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ des bdag bsod nams dbang phyug la rjes gnang lung dang bcas pa gnang ba'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
